case_name: Shri G T Suresha vs Shimoga City Municipal Council

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Sri. G T Suresha, son of Late G. Thirupal
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. Shimoga City Municipal Council; 2. Directorate of Municipal Administration

facts_of_case: Petitioner's father was a Poura Karmika (Group-D) who died in service. Petitioner claimed appointment on compassionate grounds, which was rejected by respondents.

legal_principles.principle: Illegitimacy does not justify treating children as lesser
legal_principles.held: There is no justification to treat illegitimate children as lesser children.
cited_cases: Sri. Mahaveer @ Vilas Shanthappa @ Shantagowda Patil and others Vs. Sri. Sukumar Tulajagounda patil and others, ILR 2011 Kar. 2077

legal_principles.principle: Legitimate children of void marriages are entitled to equal treatment
legal_principles.held: Any child of such marriage would have legitimate if the marriage had been valid shall be legitimage, whether such child is born before or after the commencement of the Marriage Laws (Amendment) Act, 1976.
cited_cases: Sri. Mahaveer @ Vilas Shanthappa @ Shantagowda Patil and others Vs. Sri. Sukumar Tulajagounda patil and others, ILR 2011 Kar. 2077

outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 14.09.2010 is quashed.
